_note: Closed, checked-in inventory of normative production statements across the three pre-integration design SKILL.md files. Authored (not NLP-extracted); each statement carries a deterministic sha256[:16] fingerprint of its normalized form. The classification is a bijection over these stmt_ids.

statements.statement: §0 Classify the surface (MARKETING/APP/HYBRID/out-of-scope) before generating
§0 A governing design contract outranks these defaults; consume via design-review-gate
Ban default indigo/violet accents (#6366f1 #4f46e5 #8b5cf6 #7c3aed) and the beige/brass/espresso + olive/clay/terracotta unresearched families; no even-distribution/decorative-semantic color
§1 em-dash: zero em-dashes in generated page copy
Ban Fraunces/Instrument Serif as unjustified display defaults, the decorative one-word swap, all-caps/small labels without letter-spacing, clipped italic descenders
Ban card-as-default grouping, decorative left accent stripe, 3-col icon-in-circle grid, split-header default, double hairline table borders, emoji-as-iconography
§1 eyebrow labels are capped (concept)

Eyebrow cap = at most 1 per 3 sections (exact count); ban section numbering, version stamps, pagination on tiles, locale/weather strips, scroll cues, poetic/step labels, middle-dot chains (max one · per line)
Ban div-built fake product UI, placeholder people/testimonials/logos/metrics, CSS-blob fake imagery; design the empty/honest slot instead
Light is baseline (dark only if briefed); no calm-editorial autopilot without a written reason

Hero <=2 lines / <=20 words / <=4 text elements / CTA above fold / top padding ~6rem; nav single-line <=80px; each layout family at most once/page; zigzag run <=2; bento cells == content with >=2-3 varied; per-section mobile collapse declared
Hierarchy 3-4 levels by weight/spacing not size; micro text (<=11px) whitelisted to an enumerated role list
At most 2 visible accent uses per screen; one theme/accent/radius lock per page
§3 contrast floors WCAG AA (4.5:1 normal / 3:1 large; non-text 3:1)
Focus and state indicators treated as ALWAYS in scope for non-text contrast (a deliberately stricter pack floor); placeholder + over-image/scrim text included; dark-mode secondary text 4.5:1
Every data surface renders Loading/Empty/Error/Populated/Edge; explicit edge matrix (10k rows, 200-char strings, missing fields, 0-results, offline mid-submit)
§5 touch targets 44x44pt iOS / 48x48dp Android minimum (pointer-only exception)
Modal scrim visibly isolates foreground (~32%-black default); press/hover states never shift layout; every supported color mode rendered
On restyle, never silently change URL slugs/anchor IDs, nav labels, form field names/order, logo/wordmark, legal/consent copy; extract existing brand colors first; never regress existing a11y
§7 The pre-flight gate — a mechanical checklist that re-checks the statements above
When-NOT routing; Provenance

Per-surface ms budget table (hover 90-160 … route 240-500); standard <300ms, nothing >500ms; exit = 65-75% of entrance; distance scales duration; frequency scales duration down; never animate keyboard-initiated actions
Enter ease-out / exit ease-in / move ease-in-out / mechanical linear; named bezier defaults (M3 standard/emphasized, CSS ease)
§2 easing — refusing mislabelled bezier values (M2-as-M3, CSS-ease-as-Apple) is citation hygiene

Critical-damping formula damping=2*sqrt(stiffness); preset table; momentum projection (Apple exponential-decay d~=0.998); rubber-band (c=0.55); velocity handoff w/ zero-guard; momentum dismissal velocity OR distance (~0.11 px/ms)
Stagger 30-80ms, sequence <500ms, non-blocking; one element leads; overshoot budgets (success 5-10%/celebration <=25%/errors 0%); asymmetric deliberate/response timing
§5 animate transform/opacity, not layout-triggering properties (concept)

transition:all banned; Framer x/y/scale main-thread caveat; inheriting CSS-var recalc; interruptible/retarget; never scale(0) (enter 0.9-0.97); transform-origin from trigger; gate hover behind (hover:hover)
§6 reduced motion is a floor; every animation ships a prefers-reduced-motion variant; motion never the only signal
'fewer and gentler, not zero' mapping (slide+fade->fade, spring->tween, parallax->removed)
§7 Misquoted research — do-not-cite-wrong corrections (citation hygiene, no corpus counterpart)
§8 Pre-ship gate — severity-tiered mechanical checklist
When-NOT routing; Provenance
§1 Measure before judging — font/touch/color census snippets (review method; referenced VALUES belong to ui-design-craft/corpus)
§2 The passes, in order (contract/static/states/motion/flow/consistency) — review procedure
§3 Findings + bounded fix loop + three-valued verdict (Block/Changes required/Approve) — review procedure
§4 The design contract — classification/verification/drift-direction/anti-impersonation/authoring (contract mechanics)
§5 Reviewing generated variants — anti-convergence + preference hygiene (review procedure)
When-NOT routing; Provenance
